Your Data, Explained Simply

Know exactly how your
code is handled.

We believe in straightforward answers. Here is what happens behind the scenes when you use this prototype today—and what is planned next.

1 · AI Translation

Connected AI reads your inputs

When you click to find rules or create updated code using live AI, the code and policy text you entered are sent to the connected AI service (Google Gemini or OpenAI) to generate the response. Use "Quick preview" if you want to explore the examples offline.

2 · Safe Testing

Tests run in an isolated box

When you run the test cases in Step 3, the updated code runs inside a temporary, locked-down test container with internet access turned off—checking the specific scenarios shown on screen, then deleting itself immediately.

3 · What to Upload

Use sample or non-sensitive code

Private, company-hosted deployments and team access controls are part of our future roadmap. For this prototype, stick to our built-in examples or non-confidential code snippets.
